description: This source file defines the class ReferencedTypeCollection, which manages a collection of type references with unique identifiers for serialization purposes within the Orleans framework. It provides methods to register, retrieve, and reset referenced types.

classes.name: ReferencedTypeCollection
classes.description: A collection class that manages mappings between types and their reference IDs for serialization.

methods.name: GetReferencedType
methods.description: Retrieves the type associated with a specific reference ID.

methods.name: TryGetReferencedType
methods.description: Attempts to get a referenced type by its reference ID, returning true if found.

methods.name: RecordReferencedType
methods.description: Records a type with a new reference ID.

methods.name: TryGetTypeReference
methods.description: Attempts to get the reference ID for a given type.

methods.name: GetOrAddTypeReference
methods.description: Gets the reference ID for a type, adding it if not already present.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Clears all stored type references and resets the ID counter.
